title: Geometry to Relativity
description: From smooth manifolds through Riemannian geometry to Lorentzian geometry and general relativity, with special relativity available early and a targeted topology bridge instead of a full topology prerequisite.

courses.note: Includes a targeted topology bridge in its opening units.
Special relativity and Minkowski geometry can begin before the full geometry sequence.
Requires the tensor/geometry bridge, not algebraic topology.
